summary: Commit 326261b correctly orders every Youtarr ExternalSecret at Argo sync wave -1 before controller and worker Deployments at wave 0. The patch is narrowly scoped, fully tested, and matches existing repository sync-wave conventions.
validation: Final diff contains only externalsecrets.yaml and test_render.py; no Services, Ingresses, values, secrets, generated output, or unrelated files changed.
All five rendered ExternalSecrets, including youtarr-google-oauth, receive sync-wave -1; the render test iterates over every ExternalSecret.
The render test iterates over both Deployments and asserts sync-wave 0, covering controller and worker.
Archived commit test suite passed 107 tests; Helm lint passed with zero failures.
Existing repository templates use quoted sync-wave annotations for ordered resources; this patch follows that convention.
No custom ExternalSecret health override is added; this is residual Argo health-observation risk, but does not make the ordering annotation ineffective.
next_action: Proceed to test stage for independent pipeline checks.
